sloka: तद्भवन्तः क्षताः शस्त्रैर्नृपैरिन्द्रसमैर्युधि ।चन्दनस्य रसेनेव रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः ।। ७.३१.३१ ॥
transliteration: tadbhavantaḥ kṣatāḥ śastrairnṛpairindrasamairyudhi ।candanasya raseneva rudhireṇa samukṣitāḥ ।। 7.31.31 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, you, who were wounded in battle by kings equal to Indra, are drenched in blood as if with sandalwood paste.
